abilities._comment: When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, OR Bloodrot Pox token under their control — the controller chooses which. Was hardcoded to frailty. ('Death Touch can't be played from hand' is a play restriction, not modeled here.)

_comment: Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
